task: Extract and summarize the main points from all four office notification images (combined_notifications.jpg, meeting_notification.jpg, notification_image.jpg, and power_failure_notification.jpg), and create a single PDF file named office_notifications_summary.pdf. Ensure that the summary includes separate sections for each notification, with clear headings derived from the original file names.
query_sentence: Summarize the main points from all notification images and create a unified PDF summary.

ground_truth_memory.fact: The summary PDF should be named office_notifications_summary.pdf.
Create separate sections in the PDF, one for each notification image file.
Each section should have a heading that includes the original file name or its descriptive topic.
The four notification images are combined_notifications.jpg, meeting_notification.jpg, notification_image.jpg, and power_failure_notification.jpg.
The summary should capture plausible office notification context, even if OCR text is unavailable, such as meetings and power failure notices.
